title: timetable
summary: Create a timetable from row times and variables.
description: `timetable(rowTimes, variables..., 'VariableNames', names)` creates a timetable object using the existing table storage model plus `RowTimes` metadata.
behaviors: Variables must have the same number of rows as row times.
If row times are omitted, sequential numeric row times are generated.
Table indexing methods are shared with table objects.
